claims.statement: Received the lingering blessings of the ancestors (祖宗遺澤)
Actually born on the seventh day; festival moved one day later to avoid Xizu taboo anniversary
Tianzhen Festival renamed Tianqi because of Renzong taboo name

translationRepairs: When the amnesty had been proclaimed they followed the imperial procession to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity to perform the long-life celebration rite, with the address: "The emperor, your subject So-and-so, says: Heaven blesses ruler and parent, bestowing this difficult old age; on this auspicious spring day years and virtue are renewed.

When the amnesty had been proclaimed they followed the imperial procession to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity to perform the long-life celebration rite, with the address: "The emperor, your subject So-and-so, says: Heaven blesses ruler and parent, bestowing this ageless longevity; on this auspicious spring day years and virtue are renewed.
錫茲難老 uses the classical blessing 難老 (freedom from aging / ageless longevity); “difficult old age” wrongly reads 難 as “difficult,” and “ageless longevity” correctly renders the phrase.
